common.notFoundBody: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

landing.title: Clean streets, clear accounts
landing.subtitle: Saaf Gali helps street cleaning teams plan daily duties, prove every job with photos, collect monthly fees and show residents exactly where their money goes.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything a gali safai team needs

duties.title: Daily duty roster
duties.body: Assign workers to streets by shift and see who is on duty today.

proof.title: Photo proof of work
proof.body: Before and after photos with location and time, checked by the supervisor.

fees.title: Monthly fee tracking
fees.body: Know who has paid, who is pending and the total collected this month.

hisaab.title: Public hisaab
hisaab.body: Every rupee in and out, open for the residents of each area to see.

complaints.title: Complaints with photos
complaints.body: Residents report garbage or blocked drains and follow the fix.

alerts.title: Alerts and reminders
alerts.body: In-app, email, push and WhatsApp messages for the right people.

steps.one: Areas are split into blocks and streets, and every house is listed.
steps.two: Workers clean their streets and upload photos from their phone.
steps.three: Supervisors approve the work, and residents see fees and spending.

landing.ctaBody: Log in with your mobile number and password.
landing.footer: © {year} Saaf Gali. Made for cleaner streets.

auth.loginSoon: Login with mobile number and password is coming in the next update.

admin.title: Dashboard
admin.intro: Areas, fee collection, expenses and team performance will show here.
admin.emptyBody: Once areas and households are added, your dashboard will fill up.

supervisor.title: Today's work
supervisor.intro: Check your team's attendance, review photos and handle complaints.

worker.title: Assalam-o-Alaikum!
worker.intro: Your duties for today will appear here.

resident.title: Welcome
resident.intro: See your fee bills and payments, and file complaints about your street.
